description: How AutoSA sa_sizes factors become a PE by SIMD array. A published array size is not one config.

skills.pattern: array_part, latency, and simd are treated as one tile size or as HLS pragmas
skills.strategy: array_part is the outer tile of (i, j, k). latency is the per-PE tile on the space loops, so the PE grid is array_part/latency on those loops. simd vectorizes k. The optimizer stores the whole string in sa_sizes.
required_steps: record space_time, array_part, latency, and simd as separate fields
compute the PE grid from array_part and latency before comparing two designs
guards: generic HLS unroll and partition skills do not set these factors

skills.pattern: the paper array 128x8 or 13x16x8 is compared to array_part as if those numbers were the tile
skills.strategy: Space-time 0: PEs = array_part[i]/latency[0], SIMD = simd. The manual's [32,32,32]/[8,8]/simd 2 is a 1x4 array, and the paper's design 1 is 128 PEs by SIMD 8. Space-time 3: PEs = array_part[i]/latency[0] by array_part[j]/latency[1]. [260,256,512]/[20,16]/simd 8 is 13x16x8. Space-time 4: space loops are i and k, so PEs = array_part[i]/latency[0] by array_part[k]/latency[1]. The manual's [32,4,32]/[16,16]/simd 2 is 2x2.
required_steps: divide only the space-loop dimensions by the latency factors, in space-loop order
keep j as the time tile on space-time 4; the second latency factor divides k
write the paper array as PEs by SIMD, not as array_part

skills.pattern: two designs are called the same because both are 128 PEs by SIMD 8
skills.strategy: A PE by SIMD shape is not one sa_sizes. The earlier mm1024 space-time 0 set has nine 128x8 tilings. Candidates 17, 20, 23, and 26 are within 10% of the model on HLS kernel min. Candidates 15, 25, 28, 31, and 32 are not. Candidate 15 is just outside 10%. Candidate 32 is several times the model.
required_steps: compare model latency to HLS kernel min per sa_sizes, not per PE by SIMD shape
keep array_part j and k in the row even when the PE count matches
guards: do not mark every 128x8 row within 10%
within 10% here means abs(HLS kernel min - model) / model <= 0.10
